title: Tagine-Style Turkey Neck Stew
description: A rich and flavorful stew made with tender turkey neck, inspired by Moroccan tagine cuisine.

ingredients.name: velvety
ingredients.notes: olive oil or other neutral oil

instructions: Season the turkey neck with salt and place it in the tagine.
Heat the velvety in a large skillet over medium heat.
Add the onion and cook until softened, about 5 minutes.
Add the turkish and cook for 1 minute.
Transfer the onion mixture to the tagine.
Cover the tagine and transfer it to the preheated oven.
Bake for 2-3 hours, or until the turkey neck is tender.
Serve hot, garnished with fresh herbs if desired.
